name: Panther Mastery
summary: At Nesingwary's Expedition, Sir S. J. Erlgadin tests those who seek a place in Hemet's hunt. They must bring down ten young panthers to prove their skill at tracking.

sections.title: A Crack Group of Hunters
sections.body: Hemet Nesingwary has gathered seasoned big-game hunters in northern Stranglethorn Vale. Sir S. J. Erlgadin asks newcomers to prove they can hunt panthers before they join the party.

sections.title: Tracking the Prowlers
sections.body: Before trusting newcomers with larger game, Erlgadin sets them a test. They must find and slay ten young panthers. Finding the prowlers is only half the challenge.

faq.answer: Sir S. J. Erlgadin gives the challenge at Nesingwary's Expedition camp in northern Stranglethorn Vale. He tests newcomers who hope to join Hemet's hunting party.

aliases: what do i kill for panther mastery
faq.answer: Hunters must track and slay ten young panthers in the surrounding jungle brush.

faq.q: Why does Sir S. J. Erlgadin assign this test?
faq.answer: Hemet Nesingwary has gathered a seasoned hunting crew. Erlgadin asks newcomers to prove they can hunt panthers before joining the hunt.

faq.q: What comes next after completing this hunt?
faq.answer: After this opening trial, Sir S. J. Erlgadin sets a harder hunt in Panther Mastery two.
